facts.text: [low] For users of the Datadog gov sites (app.ddog-gov.com, us2.ddog-gov.com), instrumentation telemetry is not available but is enabled by default. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/query/query_stats/README.md

[low] To avoid errors, users of the Datadog gov sites (app.ddog-gov.com, us2.ddog-gov.com) should disable instrumentation telemetry by setting `DD_INSTRUMENTATION_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false` on the application and `DD_APM_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false` on the Agent. Sources: https://docs.datadoghq.com/tracing/configure_data_security/
